If you only have half an hour, read the introduction, the type table, the main cliff figure, and the primary experiment table. If you want to go deeper, focus on three questions: whether the taxonomy transfers beyond the artifact distribution they collected, how the counterfactual safety labels are constructed, and whether the typed-memory idea can be moved upstream into training objectives rather than remaining a runtime patch.10e:T52f,Proposes the “agentic compositional generalization” hypothesis: terminal-agent competence is hierarchical, with (i) low-level atomic skills (command execution, file edits, tool usage primitives, domain snippets) and (ii) high-level behaviors that compose and coordinate those skills (task decomposition, planning, verification, error recovery, skill routing). The hypothesis claims SFT (plus pretraining/mid-training priors) primarily equips skills, while RL primarily shapes high-level behaviors via reward signals; generalization requires both skill coverage and reusable behaviors.

Based on this, introduces River (Reward-Integrity Verified Environments for RL), focusing on reward signal quality:
1) Verifier-aware filtering: discard synthetic environments with unreliable or easily exploitable reward/verifier signals, keeping a smaller but cleaner subset.
2) Behavior-level regularization: add training-time regularization targeted at behavior patterns to improve verifier alignment and suppress opportunistic strategies (the exact form should be checked in the method section).

The overall recipe is a division of labor: use SFT/data to fill missing atomic skills; spend RL budget on shaping high-level decision-making and self-check behaviors rather than learning fine-grained skills from sparse terminal rewards.10f:T56c,OptiMAS builds all agents on a shared ReAct-style execution primitive. Each agent alternates between thought, action, and observation. Multi-agent coordination is implemented through a proactive assign-deliver protocol: a parent agent delegates a subtask as a tool call, the sub-agent solves it, and the result is returned as a structured observation. This removes the need for a fixed workflow while still keeping execution structured.

The optimization scope covers prompts, role definitions, skill descriptions, tool access, model choices, and the directed collaboration graph among agents. To avoid unstable free-form code generation, tools are selected from a predefined macro-library. The collaboration graph is constrained to be a DAG, which helps prevent uncontrolled recursive delegation.

The main departure from search-based MAS evolution is the optimization loop. A candidate MAS runs on training tasks, producing full interaction trajectories and task-level metrics. These are converted into a textual loss signal for an agentic optimizer, which induces textual gradients and edits the MAS configuration. A dual-track memory mechanism stores, validates, and retrieves optimization insights across a long evolution horizon. The central contribution is not a new prompt template, but a continuous, memory-supported optimization process for evolving the whole MAS configuration.110:T4eb,BrowserForge has four main components. First, open-web URL sourcing and cleaning: candidate URLs are drawn from Common Crawl and filtered into a large pool of real, reachable, publicly accessible websites. This replaces fixed website whitelists with the open web itself as the source of diversity. Second, parallel browser sandbox orchestration: a cluster manager schedules hundreds of browser sandboxes through a shared work queue, turning web interaction collection into a high-throughput process. Third, a Proposer–Solver synthesis loop: a Proposer agent inspects a rendered page and proposes an executable task, and a Solver agent attempts the task and records the trajectory. Structured page information such as the accessibility tree is used only during synthesis as an auxiliary signal; it is not part of the deployed agent’s inference input. Fourth, verification and cleaning: rule-based and model-based filters remove invalid or low-quality trajectories, and the surviving reasoning traces are rewritten into a unified chain-of-thought format. The design choice is deliberate: use structure when generating and validating data, but keep the final policy interface purely visual to avoid HTML/a11y brittleness and token overhead at inference time.111:T7e9,The method is built around a single universal meta-operation, Ω. Ω itself is never modified. At each depth, Ω reads the full execution context of the solver stack below and writes the next layer of code. That layer is constrained to two artifacts: a short task-level pre-process that injects strategic context before solving, and a small helper library that the solver can call. This restriction is important. It narrows the search space and makes each layer act more like a strategy-and-tools writer than a full system reimplementation.

The recursive gain comes from what each new Ω call can see. Depth k does not only observe which tasks failed. It also sees the code produced by depth k-1 and the traces resulting from that code. This gives the next layer a way to evaluate prior improvement mechanisms, not just prior answers. That is the main difference from flat self-refinement loops, which usually revise outputs based on error feedback but do not reason explicitly about the code or policy that produced those outputs.

The paper frames this as emergent depth. Lower layers fix local failures. Higher layers identify cross-task regularities, write reusable helpers, decide when to suppress a previous heuristic, and sometimes override an earlier strategy entirely. To grow such stacks, the authors use an evolutionary archive rather than a single greedy chain. Multiple candidate layer chains are maintained, evaluated, and extended. This matters because layer interactions are path-dependent; a single chain can get stuck early.

A key control is the non-recursive variant. It preserves the capability of a single Ω call but removes recursive access to prior generated code and stacked layers. That ablation is meant to isolate the value of recursion itself. Relative to self-modifying agents, OpenEvolve-style systems, or explicit meta-scaffolding methods, the distinguishing choice here is simple: do not rewrite the improver; let the same improver operate on an increasingly complete history of the system.112:T74c,The evaluation spans eight benchmark families, including combinatorial optimization, text classification (the paper explicitly mentions Symptom2Disease and LawBench), terminal-agent tasks, mathematical discovery (including AlphaEvolve Math and ARC-AGI-2), symbolic regression, and algorithm speedup. Results are reported on two backbones.

The cleanest quantitative result is the recursion ablation on CO-Bench. Removing recursion drops archive-best validation from 0.845 to 0.714, an absolute gain of +0.131 from recursion alone. The authors present this as the main evidence that the benefit is not just a stronger one-shot meta-prompt, but the recursive structure itself.

The paper also includes a useful case study on assignment_problem. A one-shot solver writes code that imports scipy, but the sandbox lacks scipy, so the script crashes and scores 0. Flat self-refinement keeps exploring nearby import-based solutions. Meta^n at depth 2, after inspecting all 36 tasks together, notices repeated dependency failures and emits a global pre-process plus helper functions, including a rule to avoid scipy and a validate_output utility. The resulting solver reimplements the Hungarian algorithm and reaches a score of 1.0. Depth 3 then reasons over both the traces and the depth-2 code, deciding whether to keep, refine, or replace that strategy.

The paper claims gains over prior self-improving agents across all benchmark families, with larger margins on harder held-out tasks. ARC-AGI-2 is highlighted as a stress test: Meta^n solves some held-out tasks, while OpenEvolve and Gödel Agent solve none. The exact table values are not fully visible in the provided text, so the most important thing when reading is to verify the per-benchmark depth distribution, stopping criteria, and variance across archive candidates rather than relying only on headline claims.113:T475,Start with the Introduction and §2.1. Those sections define the paper’s taxonomy of self-refinement, explicit meta-level systems, and self-modifying agents. If that framing is not convincing, the rest of the paper becomes much less compelling.

Then read §2.2 to §2.4 carefully. Focus on three questions: what exactly a single Ω layer reads and writes; what extra information recursion introduces; and why the authors need an evolutionary archive instead of a single expanding chain. Those sections contain the real mechanism.

In the experiments, prioritize three pieces. First, the recursion ablation, because it isolates the claimed source of gain. Second, the hardest benchmarks, especially ARC-AGI-2 and tasks requiring cross-task abstraction, to see whether deeper layers are actually non-redundant. Third, the case studies involving dependency failures, helper libraries, and strategy override, because they make the layer semantics concrete.

A practical skim takes about 25–35 minutes. If time is short, inspect Figure 1, Figure 2, the main CO-Bench table, and the appendix comparison against prior meta-improvement systems.114:T497,All methods are built on a shared primitive, solve(x, c), which makes one model call with optional prior context and extracts an answer. The baseline is a single solve call. Grow performs additive recursion by extending one reasoning path; Prune performs reductive recursion by decomposing the problem, solving subproblems, and recomposing; Branch samples multiple alternative traces and selects or aggregates among them. A practically important contribution is the explicit finalization step inside solve. Some modern reasoning models produce hidden deliberation before visible output; if the token budget is exhausted during hidden reasoning, the API may return successfully but with empty visible content and a length stop. Treating that as a wrong answer unfairly penalizes methods that make more calls. The paper therefore adds a finalization mechanism to salvage budget-exhausted traces into explicit answers when possible. On evaluation, the authors use paired scoring: within each model × benchmark cell, operators are compared only on the exact set of items completed by all operators, and unrecoverable transport failures are excluded rather than marked incorrect.115:T408,This is not a direct pretraining-method paper, but it is highly relevant to post-training agents, long-context modeling, trajectory representation, and multi-model interfaces. The key reason is that it isolates a capability that standard next-token evaluation barely measures: continuing trajectories produced by another policy. For foundation-model research, that suggests two things. First, current models may be well adapted to extending their own trajectories but poorly adapted to inheriting foreign ones, which points to a missing training distribution over handoff-style contexts. Second, repository state and natural-language/tool trajectories are not symmetric in value: strong models are often burdened by weak-model trajectories, while weak models benefit from strong-model trajectories. That has direct implications for agent memory compression, handoff protocols, and multi-model pipelines. The contribution is mainly empirical and diagnostic, but the scale and clarity make it a strong baseline for future method work.116:T9bf,The paper does not propose a new agent architecture. Its main contribution is a carefully controlled experimental framework for studying handoff direction, timing, and interface. Experiments are run on SWE-bench Verified using the same mini-swe-agent scaffold, tools, and prompts across conditions, with only the model pairing and handoff strategy changed. Within each family, the authors define LC and HC models, representing lower-cost/lower-capability and higher-cost/higher-capability variants, and instantiate this setup for both Claude and GPT families.

The central design variable is the handoff interface: what exactly is transferred to the receiving model. Four interfaces are defined. Raw passes the full prior trajectory. Compact pre asks the outgoing model to summarize the trajectory and passes only that summary. Compact suf lets the receiving model read the trajectory, compress it itself, and continue from the summary. Traj-drop removes the trajectory entirely and preserves only the working tree, namely the edited repository state on disk. This decomposition is important because it separates process information from environment state and allows the study to ask whether the receiver needs reasoning trace, current code state, or both.

Timing is also handled carefully. Instead of switching after a fixed number of steps, the paper defines switch points as percentiles of the starting model’s step-count distribution. That avoids unfair comparisons caused by variable trajectory lengths across tasks and models. For escalation (LC to HC), the authors add two restart controls: Abort + HC fresh and LC-full + HC-full. These controls charge the cost of LC work already spent but discard its trajectory, and in some cases its edits, before restarting HC from the original task state. This directly tests whether continuing a weak-model trajectory is actually better than abandoning it and starting over.

The technical value lies in the factorization of the problem and the experimental controls rather than in a new algorithm. The paper treats handoff as a distribution-shift problem: the suffix model no longer conditions on contexts sampled from its own policy, but on contexts sampled from another model’s policy. Raw continuation therefore is not just “more context”; it is continuation under foreign planning assumptions. The compaction and trajectory-drop variants are designed to identify which parts of that inherited context help and which parts contaminate.117:T870,The study is large. The main setup includes 58 configurations per model family, 58,000 runs in total, and about 36 billion processed tokens. Evaluation is done on SWE-bench Verified, using executable pass/fail issue resolution and cost-quality tradeoffs as the main outcome.

Three findings stand out. First, in escalation settings, the default Raw continuation recovers less than half of the HC quality advantage in both model families. The Claude family is especially striking: even after charging for the LC prefix, abandoning the run and restarting with HC is both cheaper and more accurate than continuing the LC trajectory. That suggests weak-model trajectories can be so contaminated that a stronger model cannot efficiently repair them.

Second, in downshift settings, Raw continuation is often a reasonable strategy. When LC inherits an HC trajectory, it retains substantial quality gains over pure LC while remaining cheaper than running HC end to end. The balance differs by family: Claude preserves more of LC’s cost advantage, while GPT preserves more of HC’s quality advantage. In other words, strong-model-first and weak-model-finish can work, but the exact tradeoff is family dependent.

Third, the handoff interface matters a great deal, and the effect is directionally asymmetric. In escalation, reducing LC trajectory information usually helps: compaction improves savings, while trajectory removal improves quality recovery. This implies that detailed LC reasoning is often a liability for HC. In downshift, removing HC trajectory information while keeping only the working-tree edits hurts quality across both families, showing that LC depends on HC’s process guidance and cannot rely on final code state alone.

The full paper also sweeps seven switch points and calibrates them by task difficulty, which makes the conclusions more robust than a single arbitrary handoff time. Readers interested in the finer structure should inspect the cost-pass curves by switch percentile and the family-specific differences between Claude and GPT, since those details reveal how the handoff tax is distributed rather than only its average size.118:T5fa,For a skim, start with the introduction and Figure 2 so the four handoff interfaces are clear. The key to the paper is not merely that switching models can hurt, but that the damage depends on what information is inherited. Then read the experimental framework, especially the percentile-based switch-point definition and the restart controls. Those choices are what make the comparisons credible.

In the results, prioritize three groups of figures: cost-quality curves for LC to HC and HC to LC, interface comparisons among Raw, Compact, and Traj-drop, and trends across switch timing. By that point, the main message is already clear. Three follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind. First, can the handoff tax be reduced by continued-trajectory pretraining or SFT, where models are explicitly trained to inherit intermediate states produced by other models. Second, the gap between Compact pre and Compact suf is effectively measuring who is better at trajectory distillation, which may itself be a trainable capability. Third, the complementarity between working-tree state and language trajectory suggests that agent memory should not be treated as a single compressed context; it may need explicit separation between environment state, decision trace, and failed hypotheses.119:T5ff,SMITH is a schema-grounded multi-task RL framework. A single policy alternates between two task types. In build tasks, the model receives N=4 input-output examples and must infer a general procedure, then emit both executable Python code and an OpenAI-style JSON schema describing the callable interface. The generated tool is evaluated on K=16 held-out queries, so the model is rewarded for reusable abstraction rather than memorizing the demonstrations. In use tasks, the model sees only the schema, not the underlying code, and must invoke the tool to solve a new query. This is the key design choice: if the schema is ambiguous, underspecified, or poorly typed, the use task will fail, feeding a direct signal back into tool construction. Training uses DAPO, a clip-higher GRPO-style on-policy RL method intended to stabilize entropy and reduce reward collapse. Rewards are decomposed into three axes: execution accuracy, an LLM-judge score for schema/implementation quality and usability, and format consistency. The decomposition matters because schema failures, code failures, and answer failures are different error modes. To reduce circular evaluation, the judge is not tied to the live policy weights; instead, it is periodically synchronized from policy snapshots, allowing the evaluator to improve over time while remaining stable enough for training. Another important choice is to evaluate tools built from easier examples on harder downstream queries, explicitly selecting for reusable interfaces and general procedures.11a:T58d,The main result is on 13 procedural task families from Reasoning-Gym. A 4B Qwen3 model trained with SMITH reaches 79.8% macro accuracy on held-out Reasoning-Gym, outperforming inference-time tool-writing systems such as LATM, CRAFT, Trove, and KTCE, as well as some models distilled from much larger teachers. The paper also claims that, despite using fewer decoding tokens, SMITH beats a 30B inference-time tool writer on unseen tasks, which supports the idea that internalized tool-building can be more efficient than regenerating tools at test time. Transfer results are broader than the training domain: zero-shot gains are reported on TabMWP-Hard and on GQA, with up to +7.6 points over same-backbone baselines on GQA, even though the model was not trained on tabular or visual data. The interpretation is less about visual understanding per se and more about transferable procedural/tool abstraction. There is also a cross-model result: tools written by the 4B policy help a frozen 350M model match the performance of a 30B tool writer, suggesting that the generated tools themselves are portable assets. The same recipe is reported to improve Qwen3-8B and Granite-3.3-8B as well. The most informative ablations are the ones showing that joint build+use training beats training either skill alone, reward decomposition beats a single reward, and schema-only use encourages cleaner interfaces than exposing raw code.11b:T6cb,The method is deliberately split into two layers. First is the belief model. Let Y∈{0,1} denote whether the junior agent would ultimately be correct if it completed the response on its own. At each generation step, the model emits a competence-evidence signal, such as normalized token entropy or next-token margin. These signals are not treated as calibrated probabilities. Instead, they are mapped, from labeled trajectories, into a competence posterior B_t=P(Y=1|e_1,...,e_t). Under an idealized conditional i.i.d. signal model, the paper derives a simple log-odds recursion and proves that the posterior process is a martingale. Second is the stopping decision. Continuing incurs junior-model token cost but may reveal more evidence; escalating incurs senior-model cost plus handoff overhead. This yields a finite-horizon optimal-stopping problem. The paper derives a closed-form myopic threshold and then characterizes the optimal policy via dynamic programming, proving that the optimal rule is a time-varying threshold in posterior space. A notable technical point is that the threshold result is obtained through monotonicity arguments, without relying on concavity or monotone-likelihood assumptions on the raw signal. The regret analysis is the other key contribution. Excess cost is tied explicitly to posterior miscalibration, and the plug-in policy gets a finite-sample guarantee decaying on the order of 1/sqrt(n) with the number of labeled calibration trajectories. On the implementation side, inference is streaming, thresholds are computed offline by backward induction, and handoff is done at the text level rather than through hidden-state transfer, which keeps the method compatible with practical API-style cascades.11c:T4ff,The empirical section is structured to validate theory rather than maximize benchmark coverage. First, controlled simulations with a known data-generating process are used to test the paper’s predictions: posterior separation behavior, threshold structure, and the dependence of regret on calibration quality. This is where the Chernoff-rate separation result is made visible empirically. Second, the authors run a preregistered real-model protocol on a Qwen2.5-Coder cascade. The goal is not a broad benchmark sweep, but checking whether the theoretical predictions survive contact with an actual LLM system. The paper states that two predictions are confirmed in this real setting, with the most important practical message being that a learned competence posterior is better than thresholding raw uncertainty directly, and that calibration quality dominates the final cost. Third, the paper studies how the amount of labeled calibration data affects policy quality, matching the finite-sample plug-in regret result. The available full-text excerpt does not include reliable table values, so it would be unsafe to invent exact gains, token savings, or pass-rate improvements. The paper should be read as a theory-plus-validation piece, not as a benchmark-heavy systems paper.11d:T517,MHS is built around a model-agnostic standardized hardware driver. The driver translates device-specific interfaces into simple primitives such as read, for retrieving temperature, images, curves, or other state, and write, for setting temperature, positions, laser parameters, or other controllable values. Devices are made discoverable in a standard format so that agents and instruments can find and communicate with each other across networks without custom translators. A second important design is the use of natural-language tags. Many hardware-relevant facts are not visible from code alone, such as the weight of a robot arm, operating limits, what the device can measure, and what can be safely adjusted. MHS lets users enter this information directly, or have an agent interview them about the setup. The driver then produces a reference file describing the device’s capabilities and enforced safety limits. Control is exposed through MCP, command-line interfaces, and code-file APIs. Online model reasoning is used for high-level supervision, monitoring, fault handling, and parameter updates, while long-running or fast operations can be compiled into deterministic scripts. This separation is important because physical control often needs low latency, reproducibility, and auditability.11e:T4e0,The blog reports a research preview and partner deployments rather than a controlled benchmark with ablations. The reported integration claim is that MHS can reduce setup work from weeks or months to hours or minutes. Carnegie Mellon used MHS for serial dilution dose-response experiments and reports roughly a 3x speedup, with an agent orchestrating a liquid handler, plate reader, robotic arm, and monitoring cameras across three computers with incompatible interfaces. QuEra used MHS to give an agent control over parts of the laser system in neutral-atom quantum machines; the agent-developed controller recovered laser lock 99.3% of the time without human intervention. Other deployments include Genentech automating a BCA protein assay across a liquid handler, robotic arm, and plate reader; University of Washington work on remote monitoring, agent-supervised qPCR, and collision-free plate handoffs; HHMI Janelia unifying a microscopy rig that previously depended on seven vendor programs; and Tetsuwan integrating MHS with ResearchOS for a qPCR workflow. First, a controlled measurement study. The authors benchmark nine production tokenizers and evaluate five languages that have standardized Cyrillic and Latin representations: Ukrainian, Serbian, Kazakh, Azerbaijani, and Moldovan, totaling 8.37 million word forms. They use corpus-level fertility and define Ukrainian overhead relative to English as R(t)=F(t,BrUK)/F(t,Brown). The cross-script setup is important: comparing the same language in Cyrillic versus Latin helps isolate tokenizer-script mismatch from semantic or corpus-content differences.

Second, tokenizer retraining rather than post-hoc vocabulary patching. The paper argues that modern tokenizers already contain Cyrillic characters, so the bottleneck is not character absence but insufficient higher-order merges. To test this directly, they train balanced byte-level BPE tokenizers with different English-Ukrainian allocations under a fixed 200K vocabulary budget. The mechanism is straightforward: if Ukrainian appears often enough during tokenizer training, BPE can learn longer and more reusable Cyrillic subwords, reducing fragmentation. The best balanced tokenizer converges at 158,184 actual entries, which also suggests that effective allocation matters more than simply pushing vocabulary size upward.

Third, inference-time mitigation via prompt compression. They evaluate LLMLingua-2 because its XLM-R backbone is multilingual and can be applied to Ukrainian without language-specific fine-tuning. This is framed correctly as a mitigation, not a root-cause fix. The paper also includes a romanization comparison, not as a policy proposal but as a diagnostic: if Latinized Ukrainian is not consistently cheaper in a controlled setting, then UTF-8 byte length alone cannot explain the observed overhead.120:T68a,There are four results worth retaining.

First, the production-tokenizer benchmark. Across nine commercial tokenizers, Ukrainian incurs 68% to 121% token overhead relative to English on modern tokenizers, and 220% on the older cl100k. This shows the issue is broad rather than model-specific.

Second, the cross-linguistic script comparison. For the five languages with standardized Cyrillic and Latin forms, the overhead tracks the script that is dominant in web usage and, by implication, in tokenizer training data. That pattern supports the training-allocation explanation more than a pure Unicode-byte explanation.

Third, balanced tokenizer retraining. With a 200K vocabulary cap, a balanced English-Ukrainian tokenizer reduces the UK/EN ratio from 2.22x to 1.30x, with the best model converging at 158,184 actual entries and reported significance at p < 0.0001. This is the most actionable result in the paper.

Fourth, a production-like benchmark on 1,536 real e-commerce products with deterministic evaluation. The full paper uses this section to show that corpus-level fertility differences propagate into practical prompt budgets, and that prompt compression and tokenizer retraining are complementary. The abstract excerpt does not expose all task-level numbers, but the role of this experiment is clear: it validates that the tokenization gap is operational, not merely corpus-analytic.

One careful detail deserves mention: the paper reports a negative association between Cyrillic vocabulary allocation and overhead (Spearman rho = -0.536), but it is not statistically significant (p = 0.215, n = 7). The direction is plausible; the evidence is still limited.121:T41f,This is a skim paper unless you work directly on multilingual tokenization. Then read the cross-script design carefully, because that is the paper’s main control against semantic confounds.

The balanced tokenizer section is the part worth reading closely. It answers why retraining the tokenizer may be more effective than patching an existing vocabulary. The prompt-compression and e-commerce sections can be read more selectively. If you plan to reproduce or extend the work, spend the extra time on tokenizer training details and corpus composition.122:T467,The proposed method is likelihood-array regression, or LAR. For each target token, a fixed scoring language model evaluates the token under a sequence of nested left-context windows rather than only under the full prefix. These evaluations form a structured array indexed by context length and relative token position, with additional features derived from the model’s predictive distribution. Arrays from documents of different lengths are aligned onto a common domain. LAR-1 learns additive contributions from individual cells to the class log odds and aggregates them over tokens and context lengths. LAR-2 adds within-path second-order features for the same target token, including same-context quadratic terms and products across different context lengths. Basis expansions and random squared projections produce finite-dimensional representations, which are estimated with ridge logistic regression. The theory analyzes the within-path quadratic model, decomposes finite-estimator error into approximation, regularization, estimation, and squared-projection components, and connects prediction error to AUC convergence.123:T40c,The technical core has two parts. First, the paper uses Scheffé response-surface models, which are designed for variables constrained to the probability simplex. A first-order Scheffé model represents additive domain effects. A second-order model adds x_i x_j terms, capturing pairwise deviations from additivity: a domain pair can be better or worse together than expected from their individual contributions. Because the number of interactions grows quickly with the number of domains, the paper uses sparse second-order Scheffé models, keeping the response surface interpretable and less prone to overfitting when proxy data are limited. Second, the paper treats proxy mixture choices as an optimal design problem. Instead of sampling candidate mixtures randomly, it constructs model-robust I-optimal designs. 看成介质内部应力的历史积累。这样一来，Muon 的正交化方向不再只是工程技巧，而被解释为在输出侧安全预算约束下的最大耗散响应；而 momentum 不再只是单一 EMA，而应由介质的应力松弛谱决定，真实介质通常不止一个时间尺度，因此单时间常数未必是合适近似。","importance":"对预训练研究的意义主要有两层。第一层是方法层：它给 Muon 这类近年表现很强、但解释相对薄弱的优化器补上了一个可推导的理论框架，而且这个框架不是事后拟合某个公式，而是直接导向了一个新优化器 Bi-Maxwell。第二层是研究范式层：它把“优化器设计”从经验搜索往“由训练动力学假设推出算法结构”推进了一步。对于大模型预训练，这种工作的重要性不在于某个 benchmark 快了几十步本身，而在于它提出了一个可测量、可随训练阶段变化的量——最优记忆长度。这个量如果成立，会直接影响 warmup 之后的 β 调度、不同层/不同矩阵的时间常数设计，以及后续把 optimizer state 做成更细粒度动态系统的可能性。贡献量级上，我会把它看成‘对 Muon 家族有实质推进、对更广义优化器研究提供了一个值得验证的建模框架’，不是已经定论的通用答案，但明显超过普通小修小补。","technical_approach":"技术路线分成两部分。第一部分是从响应模型推导 Muon 方向。作者把权重矩阵的更新写成一个受约束的响应问题：在给定输出侧安全预算下，寻找能最大化耗散的响应方向。这里“安全预算”约束的是更新对输出的影响不能过大，而“最大耗散”对应的是在当前受力下尽可能有效地消耗能量。沿这个思路，最优响应会落到 momentum 矩阵的正交极分解方向，也就是 Muon 使用的 semi-orthogonalized update。换句话说，Muon 不是在做逐元素自适应缩放，而是在矩阵几何上选择一个谱范数意义下更稳、更能保持各向同性推进的方向。它和 AdamW 的区别也在这里：AdamW 主要是坐标级别的二阶统计预条件；Muon 更像是在矩阵层面控制更新的形状，避免某些奇异值方向过强、某些方向过弱。\n\n第二部分是从介质应力松弛推导双时间尺度 momentum。经典 momentum 默认只有一个指数衰减时间常数，相当于假设内部应力只有单一松弛模式。作者认为这对真实训练动力学过于粗糙，于是借用 Maxwell 型粘弹模型，把内部应力分解为快、慢两个分量，各自用不同 β 追踪，再组合成最终用于 Muon 正交化的 momentum。算法上，Bi-Maxwell 尽量保持与 Muon 兼容：正交化、其余训练 recipe、甚至 benchmark 环境都不改，只替换单一 EMA 为双 EMA 记忆。这样做的好处是因果关系更清楚，性能变化更容易归因于“记忆结构”而不是别的工程细节。\n\n从全文表述看，作者还强调一个关键点：最优记忆长度不是常数，而应随训练阶段变化。早期梯度方向变化快，长记忆会把过时方向拖进来；后期方向更稳定，长记忆能更好降噪并积累一致信号。Bi-Maxwell 不是显式做时间调度，而是用两个固定时间尺度去近似一个随阶段变化的有效记忆长度，这比手工 schedule 更稳，也更容易直接落地。","experiments":"实验最关键的是两个结果。第一，Bi-Maxwell 在 modded-nanogpt 这个公开 optimizer speedrun benchmark 上，把到达目标 loss 的步数做到 2635 步，超过当时公开记录 2690 步；如果只和不带 SOAP 等附加组件的 tuned-Muon baseline 比，也提前了 40 步到达目标。这个提升幅度不算巨大，但在一个已经被社区长期对抗式调参的公开赛道里，能只改 momentum 结构就继续前推，说明信号不是噪声级别。\n\n第二，作者做了 8 条独立训练轨迹上的只读测量，去估计训练过程中“最优 momentum 记忆长度”的变化。结论是早期最优记忆短，后期逐渐变长，与他们的应力松弛解释一致。这个实验的价值不在于绝对数值，而在于它把一个过去通常只能靠 sweep β 间接猜的超参数，变成了可以沿训练过程被观测和讨论的对象。\n\n从摘要和正文可见，论文还强调比较的公平性：不是作者自己搭了一个容易赢的 baseline，而是拿公开 benchmark 上已经被反复调过的 standing record 做对照。对优化器论文来说，这一点很重要，因为很多增益都可能来自 recipe 漂移、实现细节或评测口径变化。这里作者通过“保持 Muon 其他组件不变，只替换单时间尺度 momentum”为双时间尺度，尽量把改进归因收紧到核心假设。\n\n目前公开内容里没有看到大规模到数十亿参数的完整新训练曲线，只提到 Muon 家族本身已被扩展到 billion 级和 trillion-token 级训练。也就是说，这篇论文的直接实证仍主要集中在公开小型 speedrun 环境；它更像是‘理论驱动的小规模强验证’，而不是已经完成大规模工业复现的 recipe 定稿。","reading_guide":"建议先看 Introduction 和作者对问题的 framing，确认他们不是在重新包装 momentum，而是在重新定义“更新方向”和“记忆”各自对应的物理对象。然后重点看第 3 节，尤其是 3.2 optimizer questions that have mostly been answered by tuning rather than by theory: why Muon’s semi-orthogonalized momentum direction works, and how long momentum should remember past gradients. Instead of treating the optimizer as an empirical update rule, the authors model the weight matrix as a responsive medium with internal memory. Gradients act as external forces, parameter updates are the medium’s dissipative response under a safety constraint, and momentum is interpreted as accumulated internal stress rather than particle-like inertia. Under this view, Muon’s update direction is no longer an engineering trick: it becomes the maximally dissipative response under an output-side safety budget. Likewise, a single EMA is no longer the natural default for memory, because real stress relaxation is typically multi-timescale rather than single-timescale.","importance":"Its value for pretraining research is twofold. First, it gives the Muon family a more principled foundation and uses that foundation to derive a new optimizer, Bi-Maxwell, rather than merely rationalizing an existing heuristic after the fact. Second, it reframes optimizer design as a problem of modeling training dynamics and deriving algorithmic structure from those assumptions. For large-scale pretraining, the most interesting contribution is not the benchmark win by itself, but the introduction of an interpretable quantity: the optimal momentum memory length, which is argued to vary over training. If that picture holds more broadly, it has direct implications for beta scheduling, layer- or tensor-specific memory design, and more dynamic optimizer-state parameterizations. ","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"","category_id":"llm_pretrain","cover_url":"/covers/2608_22322.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.LG"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的是训练内存里一个常被简化的问题：优化器状态量化不能只按“Adam 的 dense 一阶/二阶矩”来设计，因为现代省内存优化器已经改变了状态的拓扑和它进入更新公式的方式。Adafactor 的二阶矩是分解的行列统计，CAME 额外维护 confidence states，APOLLO 则把统计量放到投影梯度空间里。相同大小的状态重建误差，在这些优化器里会通过完全不同的路径放大成更新误差。论文要解决的核心问题，就是如何为这些非 dense、非同构的优化器状态设计更合适的低比特表示，并且用“更新误差”和真实预训练行为，而不是单纯状态 MSE，来判断量化是否可用。","importance":"对预训练研究的意义在于，它把 optimizer-state quantization 从一个“统一 8-bit Adam trick”重新拉回到优化器语义本身。随着大模型训练越来越依赖 Adafactor、CAME、APOLLO 这类结构化状态优化器，单纯压缩 dense Adam states 已经覆盖不了真实训练栈。论文给出的启发很明确：量化方案必须同时考虑三件事——状态表示的数值分布、状态张量的拓扑结构、以及该状态如何进入 update operator。这个视角对做大规模预训练 recipe、内存受限训练、低成本持续预训练的人都很重要，因为它说明“省内存”不是只看状态字节数，还要看量化误差会不会在更新规则里被放大。贡献量级上，它更像一篇扎实的训练系统/优化方法论文，而不是改变训练范式的工作，但问题选得准，分析也比较到位。","technical_approach":"方法核心是提出 Adaptive Log-Space, AL 量化，并把它放到一个更广的分析框架里。作者先指出，很多优化器状态，尤其二阶矩和 confidence 这类非负 EMA，具有长尾、跨 block 动态范围差异大、同时又包含大量精确零值的特征。若直接用常规线性 block quantization，容易把小正值压成零，破坏“有历史”和“无历史”的语义区别。AL 的做法是：对每个 block 的正值自适应拟合一个对数区间，用 log-space codebook 表示非零部分，同时保留 code zero 专门对应 exact zero，从而满足 q=0 当且仅当 x=0 的双向精确零不变性。这样 dormant states 不会被伪造出正历史，正的二阶矩也不会因为量化塌缩成零。论文没有把所有状态一刀切成同一精度，而是采用 state-specific policy：非负状态用 AL8 或 AL16，带符号的一阶动量单独编码，CAME 的 confidence states 可以使用比二阶矩更高的精度。另一个关键点是 topology-aware grouping。作者反复强调，量化 block 的边界若切穿 Adafactor 的行/列因子，或者把不相关统计量混在一起，会显著放大 update error；因此 block granularity 和 parameter grouping 必须跟状态拓扑对齐。分析对象覆盖四条路径：dense AdamW、factored Adafactor、带 confidence 的 CAME、以及 projected-state 的 APOLLO。评估指标也不是停留在状态重建误差，而是进一步看 update-domain fidelity、temporal drift，以及量化误差经过 inverse square root、factor reconstruction、confidence modulation、projected scaling 后的传播。实现上，作者同时给了 Python reference 和 fused CUDA path，并单独验证 reference 算法一致性与 CUDA 数值一致性，这一点对训练系统论文是加分项。","experiments":"实验分成诊断和端到端两层。诊断层面，作者先从语言模型预训练轨迹里抽取不同优化器状态，比较它们的数值范围、零值模式和时间漂移，再看不同量化方案在 state reconstruction 与 update error 上的差异。结论不是“AL8 到处都最好”，而是更细的几条规律：对 dense AdamW，AL8 与所比较的 8-bit AdamW baseline 基本竞争；对 CAME，confidence states 对精度更敏感，低比特会更明显地伤害更新保真，因此更适合用高于二阶矩的存储精度；对 Adafactor，保护敏感张量、并让量化粒度与行/列因子拓扑对齐，会明显优于粗糙的统一分块；对 APOLLO，这类投影空间状态的误差传播路径又不同，说明不能把 projected states 当成普通 dense array 处理。端到端实验覆盖 20K step 的 TinyLlama-1.1B 预训练和 100K step 的 GPT-2 预训练，用来验证这些诊断是否真的对应训练行为。给出的总体结论比较克制：AL8 可以在若干路径上达到与现有 8-bit 基线相近的训练表现，但“一个统一低精度配置适用于所有结构化状态”这个想法并不成立。摘要和正文片段里没有出现完整的最终损失表格数字，因此更该关注趋势和失败案例，而不是只盯一个平均指标。","reading_guide":"如果是做训练系统或优化器的人，建议先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，把四类状态拓扑差异吃透；这决定了后面为什么不能只比较 state methods are designed around dense Adam-style first and second moments, while modern memory-efficient optimizers change both the topology of the stored state and the way that state enters the update. In Adafactor, the second moment is factored into row and column statistics; in CAME, additional confidence states modulate momentum; in APOLLO, moments live in a projected gradient space. The same reconstruction error can therefore induce very different update errors across optimizers. The paper’s core problem is how to quantize these heterogeneous states in a way that respects their numerical distribution, structural layout, and update semantics, and how to evaluate such quantization using update fidelity and real pretraining behavior rather than state MSE alone.","importance":"The main contribution for pretraining research is conceptual as much as practical. It argues that optimizer-state quantization should no longer be treated as a generic '8-bit Adam' trick. As large-scale training increasingly relies on structured-state optimizers such as Adafactor, CAME, and APOLLO, memory reduction depends not only on how many bytes are stored but also on how quantization noise propagates through the optimizer’s update rule. That is directly relevant to training recipes under memory pressure, low-cost continual pretraining, and large-batch scaling where optimizer state is a major systems bottleneck. The paper does not introduce a new training paradigm, but it sharpens the design space: representation, topology, and update semantics must be considered jointly.","technical_approach":"$c","experiments":"$d","reading_guide":"$e","authors_note":""},"recommendation":{"zh":"读实验表和各 optimizer 的精度分配即可；1.1B/20K 步证据偏小，但 AL8 二阶矩值得内部复现。","en":"Read the tables on per-optimizer precision choices; the 1.1B/20K-step evidence is small, but AL8 second moments are worth an internal replication."},"metadata":{"institutions":[],"authors":["Yan Wang"],"notable_authors":[],"tags":["optimizer-state","quantization","adamw","pretraining-efficiency","memory-optimization"],"links":{"arxiv":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22322","pdf":"https://arxiv.org/pdf/2608.22322","github":null,"project":null,"source_url":null,"article":null}}},{"id":"2608.22316","title":"Does a Modern-Handwriting Warm-Up Help Historical Arabic OCR? Its value for pretraining research lies in the modeling abstraction: noise is represented as an executable semantic error operator, not as token masking, token replacement, or a standard discrete diffusion transition. This gives a useful process-level analogue for diffusion language modeling. The key idea is to define noise magnitude by operator distance over reasoning states, then learn local inverse transitions. Corrupted trajectories are produced by composing semantic error operators. Each operator z=(κ, ℓ, u, v) records the error type, the step location, the original proposition, and the corrupted proposition. The operator library includes premise insertion and deletion, relation reversal, intermediate-value substitution, step reordering, and conclusion substitution. The forward process applies these operators to create coherent but progressively noisier reasoning states. The reverse process trains the model to identify the active semantic noise and apply the corresponding local repair. Training uses real error trajectories, synthetic noised trajectories, and interpolated trajectories between erroneous and correct reasoning. At inference time, SRD runs several denoising rounds. Each round predicts one inverse operator and checks whether it is applicable, which makes the edit more constrained than standard self-correction.","experiments":"The paper evaluates on 13 tasks spanning math reasoning, code generation, and general understanding. The authors report that a few thousand transition pairs are enough to train the SRD adapter. On six in-domain benchmarks, SRD reaches an average score of 67.5, improving over the strongest same-backbone baseline by 3.2 points and leading it on all six tasks. It is also the best same-backbone method on five of them. Transfer experiments show competitive results on Llama and the best reported Qwen3 transfer average. The evidence mainly supports sample-efficient reasoning repair; it does not yet establish this objective as a scalable replacement for pretraining-time language modeling.","reading_guide":"A 20-minute skim is enough. ","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-08-21T12:07:49Z","category_id":"efficient","cover_url":"/covers/2608_21019.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.CL","cs.AI"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作讨论的不是量化后精度掉多少，而是量化后模型的“不确定性行为”还能不能保持和全精度模型一致。更具体地说，作者把 calibration data selection 重新定义为一个目标相关的问题：如果部署场景关心的是整体概率分布、置信度、top-2 margin、重排序分数，那么应优化 distributional preservation；如果关心的是 answerability、abstention、低 margin 决策边界是否翻转，那么应优化 boundary preservation。论文要解决的核心问题，是在不改量化器本身的前提下，如何选择一小批校准数据，让量化模型尽量保留全精度模型在这些不确定性信号上的行为，而不是只保留 top-1 正确率。","importance":"对基座研究的直接意义不在预训练本身，而在“模型压缩后哪些行为会被破坏、哪些信号值得保真”这件事上给出了更细的视角。很多训练和后训练工作默认 logits、confidence、margin 这些量在部署压缩后仍可用，但这篇文章说明：即便 top-1 不变，置信度结构也可能明显漂移，进而影响 abstention、reranking、verification、ensemble 等依赖分数的系统。它的贡献量级更像一个部署侧方法学补丁，而不是范式变化：一是把 uncertainty preservation 明确成量化校准目标；二是给出 target-dependent 的形式化风险；三是用 mixture-mismatch 论证说明不存在对所有目标都合适的单一 calibration recipe。对做 pretrain/post-train 接口的人，这个结论有现实意义：训练时学到的概率结构，未必能在低比特部署中自然保留下来。","technical_approach":"方法上，作者提出 DPQ（Doubt-Preserving Quantization），它不是新的量化算法，而是一族 pre-quantization calibration data recipe。核心做法是先用全精度模型在候选样本上打分，再按部署目标挑选“脆弱样本”。两类信号最关键：一类是 high-doubt 样本，比如高熵、低置信度、小 top-2 margin，这些样本对分布扰动更敏感；另一类是 answerability boundary 附近的样本，尤其适合 SQuAD2 这类 answer/no-answer 决策。然后把这些 target-aware 样本与 generic anchors 混合，送入原封不动的量化器，例如 GPTQ、AWQ 等。论文的理论部分不复杂，但有一个有用的判断：如果目标分布更重视边界附近样本，而 calibration mixture 主要由普通 anchor 组成，那么最优校准集不会与面向 broad MCQA 的最优校准集一致；反过来也一样。这就是作者所谓 mixture-mismatch。实验里 DPQ 有多种 recipe，例如按 boundary signal 和 generic anchor 的比例配比，像 s128-r75 这类配置对应固定样本数和混合比。文章还区分了两类 preservation risk：一类是分布层面的风险，关注量化后概率分布与 FP 分布的偏离；另一类是边界层面的风险，关注低 margin 区域的决策翻转，并可用权重函数强调 answerability 或 selective prediction 场景。这个 framing 比单纯看 ECE 或 accuracy 更贴近实际系统。","experiments":"实验覆盖 8 个语言模型、9 个 NLP benchmark、22 种比较方法或配置，评测维度明显比一般量化论文更偏“行为保真”。指标除了常见的 ECE、adaptive ECE、NLL、Brier score，还包括和全精度行为直接对齐的 FP agreement、JSD(pQ, p0)、confidence shift、top-two margin drift、margin correlation，以及 SQuAD2 上的 answerability boundary 指标。主要结论有三点。第一，最优 calibration recipe 明显依赖目标：SQuAD2 这类边界敏感任务上，高 boundary mixture 的 DPQ-s128-r75 表现最好；而 broad MCQA 更偏好较温和的 recipe，如 DPQ-r50、只看 confidence 或只看 entropy 的选择策略。第二，单看 accuracy 往往掩盖了不确定性漂移；有些配置 top-1 基本不变，但 confidence/margin 指标明显恶化。第三，信号有一定可迁移性，但量化器相关性仍然存在：作者做了 post-hoc calibration 和 AWQ 分析，发现 preservation signal 不是完全绑定某一个量化器，但 score-based metric 的最优 recipe 仍带有 的 KV 后，对模型损失或输出质量有多敏感，文中用梯度相关的敏感度估计。基于这两个量，所有 KV heads 被分成三类。anchor heads 全量保留音频 KV 在 GPU 上，不参与压缩，作用是做 decode-time importance observer；tidal heads 只在 GPU 上保留一部分，其余补集放在 CPU，需要时按 chunk 召回；fixed heads The authors show that this assumption breaks badly for long audio. Prefill attention is heavily biased toward the beginning of the audio sequence, exhibiting an attention-sink pattern, while decode-time attention is spread much more broadly over the clip. The result is mildly counterintuitive: sigmoid attention is worse as a dense language model, yet it is a better substrate for learned hard KV eviction. As g approaches zero, both the weighting path and the content path vanish, making the soft mechanism approximate hard dropping. At inference, entries with g below a threshold are physically removed from the KV cache. The paper’s main hypothesis is that sigmoid attention, because it is not row-normalized like softmax, provides a cleaner local attenuation channel for learned gates and therefore makes threshold-stable deletion easier to learn. They therefore separate the problem into two parts: placement, meaning which operator expressions, model families, sizes, and weight encodings are admitted to ANE execution; and decode cost, meaning what physically dominates per-token latency after residency is achieved. set 抖动很大，理论稀疏度未必能兑现。","technical_approach":"方法核心是 predictive delta prefetching。第一步是尽早预测后续层的稀疏激活。作者不是像 DejaVu 一类方法那样到达某层时再预测该层活跃神经元，而是在 layer 0 之后，用一个单独的 GPU 驻留预测器，基于早期 token 特征一次性预测所有下游 MLP 层的 active-neuron mask。这样 sparse layer 的 I/O 计划会在真正执行这些层之前就可得，给 NVMe 预取留出时间窗口。第二步是把预测转成“增量搬运”决策。运行时为每层维护当前已驻留的权重行集合，将预测得到的下一 token 活跃集合与 resident set 做差，只从 NVMe 拉取 incoming delta，而不是重新准备整套 sparse rows。这个设计利用了相邻 token 高重叠的事实，把 I/O 成本从‘当前需要多少’改写成‘相对上一步新增多少’。第三步是面向 Jetson 这类统一内存平台处理一致性问题。作者指出 direct I/O 可能绕过 CPU cache coherence，导致 GPU 看到陈旧数据，因此运行时采用 cache-coherent staging path，再把 sparse rows 送入 GPU 执行缓冲。第四步是 memory-adaptive dense/sparse split：把有限 GPU 内存划分为完全常驻的 dense prefix 和采用活跃行缓冲的 sparse suffix。内存宽松时保留更多前层为 dense，减少调度复杂度；内存紧张时扩大 sparse suffix，提高可运行模型规模。这个设计不是单纯做层切分，而是在“早层常驻带来的稳定收益”和“后层稀疏带来的容量扩展”之间做动态折中。","experiments":"从全文可见，作者首先用系统 profiling 说明问题确实存在：在 Jetson AGX Orin 上运行 Mistral-7B、mem=14G 的场景里，解码阶段每秒约 11,453 次 major page faults，CPU 有 77% 时间阻塞在 I/O，GPU 平均利用率只有 3%。这组数字很关键，因为它说明瓶颈不是算力而是反应式取权重。方法有效性的前提观察也给了明确量化：相邻 token 的 MLP 活跃神经元有约 82–85% 延续。实验主线应包括三部分：一是预测器精度与 lookahead 是否足够早；二是 delta prefetch 相比 demand paging、普通 The paper does not introduce a new model. A central conceptual distinction is between continuous batching and synchronized batching. AR systems such as vLLM and Orca rely on the fact that active requests advance one token per iteration and can share a forward pass while completed requests are swapped out. Masked diffusion decoding advances by denoising token blocks, and different requests may require different numbers of denoising steps. Existing approaches usually pick one of three trade-offs: uniform quantization, importance-based eviction, or structural compression. Uniform quantization wastes bits on low-value tokens; eviction is irreversible and can fail when attention later shifts back to old context; structural compression often needs reconstruction, which can erase runtime gains. Minima-KV asks whether paged attention can support a retention-preserving fidelity hierarchy: old pages are downgraded rather than deleted, all live pages remain addressable, and mixed-format decode works without maintaining a cache-sized dense shadow copy.","importance":"This is not a pretraining paper, so its direct impact on foundation-model training is limited. ","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-08-24T21:30:11Z","category_id":"efficient","cover_url":"/covers/2608_23843.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.LG"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作解决的是长上下文推理中的 分别做截断 SVD 或等价低秩分解，得到 page-local basis，而不是让整段历史共享一个全局 basis。这样每个 page 都能用最适合自己的低维方向表示，避免全局分解偏向高能量但未必任务关键的方向。\n\n系统设计上有几个关键实现。1）混合缓存：保留一个小的 sink region 和最近窗口为 dense form，较早且已封页的历史部分转成 factorized form。这样做是因为最近 token 和 attention sink 往往最敏感，直接压缩风险更高。2）直接混合注意力 kernel：查询时同时对 dense pages 和 factorized pages 做注意力计算，不需要先把历史 KV 重构回原空间，避免额外带宽和算力开销。3）增量式 page 转换：在 autoregressive decoding 过程中，随着新 token 到来，某个 page 一旦填满就被异步/批量分解并转存为低秩因子，因此方法兼容在线生成，而不是只适用于 prefill 后静态压缩。4）训练和校准都不需要：不同于依赖模型权重投影空间或 calibration activation 构造 basis 的方法，PuzzleKV 完全从当前请求产生的 page 内 KV 本身做分解。\n\n从全文看，作者的主要论证链条是：先证明 page-level KV-cache eviction: deployed operators keep a subset of keys, renormalize the original attention weights over that subset, and therefore operate under forced weights. The central question is how much subset selection can still improve the approximation under this constraint, and whether reported gaps between eviction methods actually come from selection quality, memory accounting, query visibility, or extra computation.","importance":"The useful lesson for long-context inference research is that KV eviction results need byte-level accounting. The paper shows that keeping the largest attention masses is already close to the best possible subset under forced weights. If this measurement holds, increasingly elaborate query-agnostic selectors have little headroom unless they change the operator, use query information, or exploit implementation details. This matters for pretraining-oriented long-context work as well, because model and data decisions should be separated from artifacts introduced by non-shrinking cache masks or unfair budget enforcement.","technical_approach":"The analysis models one attention row as a probability vector p over value vectors v_j. Dense attention returns μ, while a kept set A returns m_A, the original weights restricted to A and renormalized. The forced-weight error is es(A)=||μ-m_A||. This is contrasted with a free-weight geometric error ef(A), where weights on the retained points may be re-solved. The paper shows that these two objectives can differ in both value and minimizer. It also proves that deciding whether the forced-weight optimum ES(s) is zero is NP-complete even in a one-dimensional uniform-mass integer setting with s=N/2. Since the exact problem is combinatorial, the authors enumerate restricted candidates and use a cheap balancing selector that starts from the top-mass set and greedily swaps retained and dropped keys when the swap reduces es(A). This selector reads the dense output μ, so it is mainly a diagnostic and decode-time tool rather than a query-agnostic cache precompression rule.","experiments":"The main measurement enumerates exact best subsets on 168,192 attention rows from five models. The best subset improves over top-mass by only a median 2% to 5% of the remaining gap to full attention. The paper then audits established eviction methods in a shared evaluation pipeline. Several strong query-agnostic methods nominally compress the cache, but their per-head selections are stored as masks over a full non-shrinking cache; true memory savings require ragged per-head storage. Enforcing the nominal budget on fixed selections costs 14.1 to 62.2 benchmark points, and an 87.6-point retrieval gap is traced to rankings computed after the question is visible. The proposed ContourKV rule is training-free, reuses existing importance scores, and physically enforces the budget before evaluation. It wins 93 of 160 comparisons against KVzip and loses 22; at matched memory it ties Compactor, supporting the claim that near-optimal forced-weight selectors should not separate much by selection alone.","reading_guide":"A 20–30 minute skim is enough for most readers. Then read the formal setup in Operator and Frozen-Head Measurements, especially the distinction between forced and free weights. reference set。对每个 query-response 对，先计算已有的 UQ 分数作为基础特征；这些分数可以来自 verbalized confidence、self-consistency 类分数、token-level 或 generation-level 启发式分数，也可以是多个分数的组合。然后再利用 reference set 做邻域特征工程：在 embedding 空间里为当前 query 找 k 个最近邻，提取这些邻居的 correctness label、相似度、邻域正确率等统计量。这样，模型不只是看“当前样本自己有多不确定”，还看“和它相似的问题上模型通常会不会错”。\n\n在学习器上，作者没有执着于单一模型，而是比较了多种低成本分类器，并把 task-dependent learner selection 当成结论的一部分。输出目标是 把能力分解后，更适合诊断训练目标、位置编码、长序列注意力和数据配比带来的具体短板。第二，它把多语言和位置控制做到了同一框架里，这对分析长上下文 scaling 是否只在英语成立、以及低资源语言为何掉队，很有帮助。对做预训练的人来说，这类 benchmark 的意义不在 leaderboard，而在于它能把“模型为什么错”暴露得更具体：是 recency bias、option-order 两类，并覆盖四层语言粒度：词级、句级、段级、文档级。文中提到的任务包括 word-level QA、sentence-level cloze、paragraph filling、document summarization、translation 等，共 7 个任务；每种语言每个任务有 420 个 query-response 对。关键不只是任务种类，而是构造时同时控制了证据位置：在文档级和段落级都标注 begin/middle/end，使得同一模型在不同位置上的退化可以被直接比较。\n\n数据来源选 UN 报告有两个原因。一个是天然多语平行和主题一致，便于做跨语言对照；另一个是文档结构较规范，适合定义词、句、段、文档四层 coherent unit。作者强调 same-position sentences 在六种语言中语义对齐，这让跨语言比较不只是“题型类似”，而是材料位置和语义都尽量一致。质量控制上，所有 query-response pair 都经过人工审查并删除有缺陷样本，明显是偏小而精的 benchmark 路线。\n\n评分方面，closed-ended 任务主要用 Accuracy，开放生成任务用 ROUGE-L 等 reference-based 指标；对于 paragraph filling 这类仅靠 n-gram overlap 很难评准的任务，又引入了 LLM-as-a-judge。这个设计比较务实：如果只用自动指标，会低估语义正确但表述不同的答案；如果全靠 judge，又会把 benchmark 的可复现性变差。MGAL 采取的是两者并用。\n\n从方法贡献看，它不是提出新的评测算法，而是把三个维度系统化了：multilingual、granularity-aware、position-aware。和 LongBench、LV-Eval、M4LE、ONERULER 这类已有工作相比，区别不在规模更大，而在控制变量更细，能支持更明确的误差归因。","experiments":"实验部分的重点不是谁第一，而是错误模式。作者评测了 12 个 long-context LLM。摘要和正文给出的主要结论有四类。\n\n第一，粒度越粗，性能越差。模型在词级任务上普遍表现较好，但从句子、段落到文档，能力明显下降。这说明很多模型的“长上下文能力”更接近局部匹配或局部检索，而不是稳定的跨段组织与全篇整合。\n\n第二，多语言差异在低资源语言上被放大。大开源模型和闭源模型在高资源语言上的差距没有想象中大，但到了低资源语言，闭源模型优势更稳定，小型开源模型掉得更明显。这个现象对预训练很关键，因为它暗示长上下文能力并不是单独由架构决定，语料覆盖和跨语言表示质量仍然是主导因素。\n\n第三，位置敏感性依然明显。sentence-cloze 中，空缺出现在文本前部时错误率最高，越靠后越好，和 recency-biased attention 的已有观察一致。作者还发现明显的 early-option bias：模型更容易选前面的选项，如 A/B，而不是逐项核对证据。这说明一部分错误不是“不会读长文”，而是推理过程被答题格式诱导。\n\n第四，作者提出了两个更细的失效现象。其一是 local semantic crowding：相邻句子共享大量实体、年份、连接词时，模型容易根据表面重叠选错句子，忽略句子在段落中的功能角色，比如背景、解释、结果。其二是 fluency-consistency gap：生成结果往往流畅、风格也对，但和输入锚定不够，容易出现 factual drift 或无依据补写。这个观察对长上下文生成很重要，因为很多模型在 summarization/filling 上看起来“像对了”，但其实证据绑定很弱。\n\n从数据规模上，benchmark 覆盖 6 种语言、7 个任务、4 个粒度、上下文长度 8K–128K，每语言每任务 420 个样本。虽然正文截断处没有完整表格数字，但这些设置已经足够支撑细粒度切片分析。若做复现实验，最值得关注的是不同模型在 begin/middle/end 和不同 granularity Single-Rule、Parallel Multi-Rule、Multi-Hop Rule 三类，共 11 个子任务。设计上的关键点有三个。第一，规则是抽象模板，带占位符，需要先做 grounding，不能靠记忆世界知识蒙对。第二，规则库是共享的，不是每题单独附带的 hint。第三，规则之间可组合，前一步结论会改变后续可用规则集合。\n\nDynaRule 侧，核心思路是把外部规则编码后直接注入 LLM 的 KV cache，并把“何时重新检索、检索哪些规则”做成解码过程中的内部动作。具体做法是：先用预训练句向量编码器把规则编码成向量，再通过单层 adapter 对齐到目标 LLM 的表示空间，然后作为可被注意到的外部 memory 注入若干层的 KV。训练分两阶段。第一阶段先找 confidence layer，也就是对注入规则的注意力熵最低的层；作者把它视为模型最能做出稀疏、确定性规则选择的层。第二阶段在该层做 Stacked Step-Level Attention Training，引入特殊 token <search>。这个 token 的作用不是输出内容，而是触发一次针对规则库的重新注意，让模型在当前推理步重新选择相关规则，并用新选中的规则替换 KV 中过时的条目。这样做的区别在于：传统 RAG 在生成前或少数固定位置检索，检索误差会一路传递；静态 KV 注入虽然避免了外部检索延迟，但目标规则一旦随中间状态变化，就容易被早期注意模式锁死。DynaRule 试图把检索和推理耦合成一个 step-level 闭环。\n\n从机制上看，<search> 更像一种显式的 latent action。它把“需要外部规则支持”这个决策暴露到 token The authors sample real user sessions, keep the first user turn verbatim together with attachments, and avoid writing reference answers. From roughly 18,000 sessions, they sample 200 and retain 178 tasks that all nine models complete, so model means are computed on the same task set. Each model runs in an identical Modal sandbox with the stock pi 0.84.0 harness and the same tools: shell, file read/write/edit, web search, content fetch, retrieval, and source checking. There are no model-specific prompts, no added scientific skills, no subagents, and no retries. 默认输入完整视频和问题，一次性输出答案；这里则把交互状态显式纳入任务：模型在看到部分视频、已生成的部分答案、以及中途插入的新指令后，需要先判断打断意图，再决定继续、修正还是终止回答。论文关心的核心不是视觉理解本身，而是在线交互中的状态建模、意图识别和响应切换能力。","importance":"对基座预训练本身的直接贡献有限，它更接近评测与面向交互场景的后训练数据构造。但它有两个启发点。第一，现有 tq 收到初始问题，模型开始自回归生成；在 ti 时刻收到 interruption，此时上下文包含 V≤ti、Q0、A≤ti 和打断信号 I。模型需要先识别 interruption type，再执行对应策略。作者把打断分成三类：Cancellation、False 构造与离线模拟协议。难点在于“生成过程中被打断”很难大规模、可复现地评测。作者设计了统一时间轴下的离线模拟：先确定问题发起时刻、打断时刻、可见视频片段和部分回答，再让模型在这个冻结状态下继续完成后续响应。这样做牺牲了一部分真实在线系统细节，但换来了批量评测和可重复比较。数据同时提供 open-ended 和 multiple-choice 两种设置：前者更接近真实交互，后者噪声更低，便于稳定比较模型能力。\n\n第三是评测指标与训练集。指标分成 interruption understanding 和 response generation 两大类，不只看最终答对没有，还看是否识别了打断意图、是否满足打断后的新目标、打断前后语言是否连贯、内容是否与视频证据一致。为了验证这不是纯 benchmark 工作，作者还构造了 Process rewards, trajectory judges, and step annotations for coding agents are often reused for SFT, RL, verifier training, or data filtering. This work shows that such signals may not identify whether a specific step caused success or failure. At the action level, it studies what predicts the next operation. At the task level, it measures uncertainty under replayed continuations. At the step level, it defines a prefix-conditioned causal effect for a particular action. The concrete instrument is SCAE, a replay-based estimator derived from a structural causal model of agent execution. Given a logged prefix and a replayable repository environment, SCAE reconstructs the prefix and estimates local effects through replayed continuations. When local overlap is available, it uses an observational branch; when the policy is effectively deterministic, it switches to an intervention branch. We introduce Kernel Token Contradiction (KTC), a lightweight approach to compute claim-level UQ under realistic white-box conditions. W","starred":false,"priority":"p3","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"","category_id":"eval","cover_url":"/covers/2608_22506.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.CL"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的是 模型做矛盾检测，推理成本高、部署复杂，而且跨语言泛化受限。论文提出 KTC，希望在白盒条件下，用更轻量的 token-level 机制替代 NLI 式 claim contradiction 检测。","importance":"这不是 pretrain 核心论文，但对基座研究仍有两层启发。第一，它把不确定性估计往 token distribution 内部推进了一步，不再完全依赖外部 邻域统计的近似方法虽然不完美，但可能更适合生产环境。就贡献类型看，它更偏评测/监控工具，而不是训练方法；对预训练研究的直接影响有限，但对后训练质量控制、数据过滤、生成置信度建模有参考意义。","technical_approach":"KTC 的核心是把 token-level 的预测不确定性和语义矛盾不确定性合并到一个 kernel 里，再用 Von Neumann entropy 做分数。直觉上，普通 token entropy 只能告诉你模型在犹豫，但不知道它是在“两个同义或近义表述之间犹豫”，还是在“两个互相冲突的事实 token 之间犹豫”。作者认为后者更接近 hallucination 风险。\n\n具体做法分四步。第一，在每个 next-token prediction 步，取候选 token，并估计 token 之间的 contradiction score。与 CCP、SAR 这类方法不同，KTC 不用额外训练或调用 NLI 模型，而是提出一个基于 Wikipedia 邻域频率统计的启发式：看 token 在语料局部上下文中的共现/邻接模式，以近似判断两个候选 token 是否表达互斥信息。这个近似显然比真正的语义推理粗糙，但计算极轻。第二，用这些 token contradiction 关系构造一个正半定 kernel，表示候选 token 集合内部的“语义分歧结构”。第三，用模型自身的条件分布对语义不确定性做缩放。作者特别强调这一步在 token-level 很关键，因为如果模型对某些矛盾 token 只给了极小概率，它们不应对最终不确定性贡献过大；这也是 KTC 相比 generation-level KLE 的一个重要改动。第四，对归一化后的 kernel 计算 Von Neumann entropy，得到 token-level uncertainty score，再聚合到 claim level。\n\n从方法定位看，KTC 介于纯 predictive entropy 和重型 semantic verifier 之间。它借鉴了 KLE 用 PSD kernel + VNE 表示不确定性的框架，但把对象从整段生成结果下沉到 token 级，并把“语义关系”从 NLI 判别替换成语料统计启发式。这种替换牺牲了一部分语义精确性，换来部署成本和速度的大幅下降。","experiments":"实验覆盖 MUCH 和 Mu-SHROOM 两个 claim-level UQ benchmark，语言包括英语、法语、德语、西班牙语，模型覆盖 16 个不同 LLM。对比方法主要是同类白盒方法，如 CCP 和 SAR。结果上，作者给出的主结论有三点。第一，整体平均性能上，CCP 仍然最好，KTC 排第二，差距不大；这说明不用 NLI 也能接近现有强基线。第二，效率是 KTC 的明显优势：在 CPU-only 条件下，相比需要 GPU 加速的现有方法至少有 8.2× 的速度提升，而且 setup 更简单，不需要额外训练 NLI 模型。第三，在高精度低召回区间，KTC 反而优于对手：当 recall ≤ 20% 时，平均 precision 达到 78%，而 CCP 为 69%。如果使用场景是只想标出最可疑的一小部分 claim，这个结果比总体平均分更有意义。\n\n论文还提到一个关键消融：用模型预测分布对 semantic uncertainty 做缩放，对 token-level UQ 很重要；没有这一步，性能会明显下降。另一个隐含结论是，基于 Wikipedia 频率统计的 contradiction heuristic 虽然简单，但足以替代 NLI 成为一个实用近似，尤其在多语言和低资源部署场景下更有吸引力。不过也要看到它的边界：这种方法更擅长捕捉数值、实体、局部替换带来的冲突，对长程语义矛盾、复杂蕴含关系的覆盖不会像 NLI 那样完整。","reading_guide":"泛读时先看 Introduction，抓住作者为什么认为“token propos","starred":false,"priority":"p3","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"","category_id":"eval","cover_url":"/covers/2608_23086.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.AI"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作解决的是黑盒 LLM 的置信度估计成本过高的问题。更具体地说，现有方法在质量和成本之间有明显张力：verbal confidence 只需一次调用，但经常过度自信、分数挤在高置信区间；sampling-based uncertainty 更能区分对错，但每个 query 都要独立采样，成本随样本数线性增长。POOL 的问题设定不是改造模型内部，而是在只能通过 API 访问黑盒模型时，能否利用一批 query 之间的语义冗余，把原本逐题计算的置信度估计摊薄到相似问题簇上，从而在尽量不损失排序质量的前提下降低 generation 成本。","importance":"它不是预训练论文，但对大模型系统和评测方法有实际启发。第一，论文把 confidence estimation 明确建模成 ranking 问题，而不是概率校准问题，这个取向很适合黑盒 API 场景，也更贴近路由、人工复核和 先映射到固定编码器的 embedding 空间，用 cosine similarity 建立语义邻域，然后做带重叠的聚类。每个 cluster 选一个 medoid，对 medoid 运行昂贵的 base estimator，得到代表该簇的置信度信号。之后，对任意 query，不直接完整运行 M，而是从它所属的多个 cluster 中收集代表分数，并按相似度做软传播和聚合，形成 query-specific confidence。\n\n这里有两个关键点。第一，cluster 是重叠的，不是硬划分。这样一个 query 可以从多个局部语义邻域接收信息，降低单一聚类失误带来的偏差。第二，作者加入 rescue budget：如果某个 query 从不同 cluster 传播来的分数分歧很大，说明局部邻域对它的判断不稳定，这时再额外花预算做更直接的估计。这个机制相当于把计算集中在高不确定、高冲突样本上，而不是平均分配给所有样本。\n\n论文还引入了一个简单 hybrid baseline，Hy@p，把 verbal confidence 和 sampling-based diversity 信号结合起来，作为更强的 per-query 基线，再让 POOL 在其上做摊销。这个设计很合理，因为如果 base estimator 太弱，传播只会放大噪声；先把单点估计做得足够稳，再做 batch-level amortization，更容易得到好的 cost-quality trade-off。\n\n从方法性质看，POOL 更像 inference-time meta-algorithm，而不是新的 uncertainty 的收益高度依赖输入批次中的冗余结构：越多模板化、近重复、同义改写，越适合用这种共享估计的方式摊销成本。反过来说，如果 query 分布高度异质、彼此独立，POOL 的优势会变弱。\n\n从实验解读上，最重要的不是某个绝对 AUROC 数字，而是 trade-off 曲线：在保留大部分 ranking quality 的前提下，能省掉多少额外生成。对于线上系统，这比单纯追求最强 Such evaluations are generally multi-dimensional, since the error patterns in texts can be different for different dimensions. Therefore, reliable LLM judges should evaluate each target dimension independently. To quantify the extent to which LLM judges depend on non-target dimensions when evaluating a target dimension, i.e., inter-dimension dependence, we propose CorrGap. To measure this, CorrGap use","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-08-24T19:26:23Z","category_id":"eval","cover_url":"/covers/2608_23783.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.CL"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的是一个常被忽略、但会直接影响 LLM-as-a-judge 可用性的问题：在多维文本评测里，模型是否真的在评“目标维度”，还是被其他非目标维度带偏。论文把这个现象定义为 inter-dimension dependence。比如评 relevance 时，judge 可能因为文本不流畅或不连贯而给低分，即便相关性本身并不差。这样一来，多维评测会退化成某种模糊的整体印象分，失去按维度诊断错误模式的意义。作者的核心目标有两个：先给出一个可量化的度量，判断这种维度串扰有多严重；再提出一个推理时干预方法，尽量让 judge 的打分依据只围绕目标维度展开。","importance":"对预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，但对 post-train、reward design、LLM judge 可靠性有明确启发，尤其适合关心 RL/RLAIF 奖励信号质量的人。很多后训练流程默认多维 rubric 或多头奖励是“可分解”的，但这篇文章说明，若 judge 在维度间存在系统性耦合，那么看似细粒度的奖励其实可能仍是混杂信号。这个问题会传导到偏好学习、GRPO/PPO 奖励建模、合成监督数据筛选等环节。贡献量级更像“评测与诊断工具 + 一个推理时修正策略”，不是范式级方法，但问题定义是扎实的，且比单纯报 judge 准确率更接近真实使用场景。","technical_approach":"技术上分两部分。第一部分是 CorrGap。它不是直接看某一维上的整体相关性，而是看：当一个样本在目标维度和其他维度上的真实分数差异很大时，judge 在该目标维度上的表现是否明显变差。作者先把每个维度的人工分数转成该维度内部的 percentile，避免不同维度原始分数分布不一致带来的偏差；然后对每个样本计算目标维度 percentile 与其他维度 percentile 均值的差值 Δ(t, d_i)。Δ 小的样本属于 low-variance group，说明目标维度和其他维度大致一致；Δ 大的样本属于 high-variance group，说明目标维度与其他维度明显背离。若 judge 能独立评估目标维度，那么它在两组上的相关性不应有系统差异；若存在维度串扰，则 high-variance 组更容易被非目标维度误导，导致相关性下降。CorrGap 就是两组相关性差值，并通过分层构造尽量控制目标维度真实分数分布，避免把“样本本来更难”误当成维度依赖。\n\n第二部分是 DimCheck。它利用 judge 先生成的 CoT 作为可编辑中间表示。流程上，先让 judge 针对目标维度给出 reasoning；再用另一个检查步骤识别 reasoning 中哪些证据与目标维度无关，例如评 factuality 时引用了 fluency 或 style 的证据；然后迭代删除这些无关证据，并让模型基于清洗后的 CoT 重新打分。这个设计的关键不是重新训练 judge，而是在推理时约束其“证据使用范围”。论文还讨论了用较小模型去近似大模型的 DimCheck 组件，以降低额外推理成本。和直接改 prompt 相比，DimCheck 的区别在于它显式操作 reasoning 内容，而不是只靠一句“请只关注某维度”的指令。","experiments":"实验覆盖四类开放式文本生成任务、三种评测框架、八个 judge 模型，以及三种用于验证和缓解的主力 LLM。全文主结论不是某个单点数字，而是现象具有普遍性：在多数任务、模型和框架组合下，CorrGap 都显著大于零，说明 inter-dimension dependence 不是个别 prompt 或个别模型的问题。作者还做了两类关键验证。第一类是度量有效性验证：在不同设置下，CorrGap 能稳定区分维度独立性更差的 judge，并且与人工观察到的 CoT 串扰现象一致。第二类是方法验证：DimCheck 相比强基线能更稳定地降低 CorrGap，并提升目标维度打分与人工标注的对齐。论文还展示了小模型蒸馏/逼近大模型检查器的结果，说明额外成本有压缩空间。由于给出的全文片段没有完整表格数字，无法可靠复述每个任务上的精确提升幅度，但从正文描述看，作者强调的是跨任务一致性和对强基线的稳定优势，而不是单一 benchmark 上的大幅提升。","reading_guide":"泛读时建议抓三处。第一看 Introduction 和 CorrGap 定义部分，重点理解作者为什么不用整体相关性，而要比较 low-variance / high-variance 两组；这里决定了这个指标是否真的在测“维度串扰”而不是“样本难度”。第二看方法细节里 percentile 归一化和分组控制的设计，这部分是在补统计口径上的漏洞，值得确认是否足够严谨。第三看 DimCheck 的案例和消融，尤其是“删除无关证据后为何能改善打分”以及“小模型近似大模型检查器”的成本收益。预计 20–30 分钟可以完成有效泛读；如果你做 reward model、judge 或 rubric-based RL，建议把实验设置和附录 prompt 也一起看。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"The paper studies a failure mode in multi-dimensional LLM judging: when a judge is asked to score one target dimension, its decision may still be influenced by other non-target dimensions. In practice, this means a relevance score can be dragged down by poor fluency, or a factuality score can be inflated by overall coherence. Once this happens, multi-dimensional evaluation collapses toward a vague overall impression score, which defeats the purpose of dimension-wise diagnosis. The paper therefore asks two concrete questions: how to measure this inter-dimension dependence reliably, and how to reduce it at inference time without retraining the judge.","importance":"This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it matters for post-training pipelines that rely on LLM judges, especially RL with rubric-style rewards, synthetic supervision filtering, and reward modeling for open-ended tasks. A key implication is that decomposed rewards are not automatically disentangled. If the judge internally mixes dimensions, the training signal remains entangled even when the interface looks fine-grained. That makes the work relevant to anyone concerned with reward quality, reward hacking, and the reliability of LLM-based evaluators. The contribution is best viewed as a diagnostic metric plus a mitigation procedure, rather than a new alignment paradigm.","technical_approach":"$82","experiments":"The experiments span four open-ended generation tasks, three evaluation frameworks, eight judge models for the diagnostic study, and three main LLMs for the mitigation study. The paper also validates CorrGap itself by showing that it aligns with observed chain-of-thought contamination patterns and can distinguish judges with worse dimension independence. For mitigation, DimCheck reduces CorrGap and improves alignment with human scores compared with strong baselines. Another practical result is that a smaller model can approximate the larger DimCheck component with lower inference cost. We formalize construct validity for an evaluator as a two-dimensional profile: invariance S, the probability that a verdict is unchanged under construct-preserving edits, and construct sensitivity R, the probability that it changes under minimal construct-changing edits. We show that S and R are independent and that no scalar summary preserves","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-08-25T11:32:54Z","category_id":"eval","cover_url":"/covers/2608_24419.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.AI"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的不是“评审模型稳不稳”，而是更基础的“评审模型到底有没有在测它声称要测的东西”。作者指出，现有 LLM-as-a-Judge 研究大多只测不变性：当答案长度、格式、候选顺序、作者元信息等表面属性变化，而真实质量不变时，judge 是否保持判决不变。但一个评测器即便在这些扰动下很稳定，也可能根本感知不到真正的质量变化。为此，论文把 construct validity 明确拆成两个独立维度：S 表示对不改变构念的编辑保持不变，R 表示对最小但真正改变构念的编辑产生响应。作者选取“科学表述是否超出证据支持范围”作为可操作构念，并进一步把 overreach 分成 scope 和 strength 两类最小编辑，检验 judge 是否真的能分辨这两种变化。","importance":"对预训练研究的直接启发不在训练方法，而在评测信号质量。现在很多 post-train、reward model、judge-based preference data、self-improvement pipeline 都默认 judge 分数可当作训练目标或筛选信号。这篇工作提醒：高一致性、高相关性、低表面偏置，并不等于评测器在测目标构念。如果 R 低，拿这样的 judge 去做偏好蒸馏、RL 奖励、数据过滤，模型会学到“与标签生成条件相关的表面代理变量”，而不是目标能力本身。这个判断对 reward hacking、合成偏好数据、自动化评测闭环都很关键。贡献量级属于评测方法论层面的纠偏：不是提出一个更强 judge，而是给出一套更严格的 judge 有效性定义、可测协议，以及对现有公开评测集‘可验证头寸’的分析框架。","technical_approach":"方法上有三层。第一层是形式化。作者把 evaluator 的 construct validity 定义为二维 profile (S, R)，并证明两点：其一，S 和 R 相互独立，不能用一个标量替代；其二，如果不知道 S，仅看 R 没有解释意义，因为一个对任何输入都乱变的 judge 也可能表现出表面上的“敏感”。因此他们引入 validity frontier，而不是单分数排序。第二层是干预设计。作者围绕 scientific overclaim 构造两类最小编辑：scope edit 改变命题适用范围，如从特定条件推广到更广人群、从一次观察改写成稳定性质、加强量词；strength edit 不改变适用范围，但提高断言强度，如去掉条件、去掉 hedge、加入 evidence 不支持的 intensifier。每个编辑方向由人工标注确定，避免把“哪边更过度”交给模型自己判断。第三层是测量与验证。作者在 7 个 judges、4 个领域上测量 S 与 R，并单独分析 scope/strength 两轴；同时提出 validation power，强调评测集是否给 judge 留出了“只能依赖构念、不能靠生成来源或表面模式猜标签”的空间。这里的关键点是 paired mode：把同一基础样本的最小编辑对拿出来看，才能真正测到 sensitivity；若只按 item 独立评估，很多数据集会因为 provenance leakage 看起来很可靠，实际并不能检验 覆盖更广，但判定标准埋在模型行为里，不透明、不可编辑，也难以稳定复用。论文把这些隐含标准明确称为 verifier inductive biases，并试图从 verifier 的残差错误中自动归纳出来，再以可审计、可回放验证的形式沉淀为规则或 prompt 更新。","importance":"对预训练本身不是核心论文，但对 post-train、RLVR、reward 建模和 benchmark 评测都很相关。原因很直接：只要训练依赖 outcome reward，verifier 的误判就会直接污染优化方向。很多 RL with verifiable rewards 工作默认 verifier 足够可靠，但实际难点常常不在算式能不能化简，而在“什么算对”这件事本身带有任务依赖的隐含标准。AutoVerifier 的价值在于，它没有再训练一个更大的 judge，而是把 verifier 改进做成一种非参数、可审计、可增量维护的过程。这对构建长期可维护的 reward pipeline 有现实意义，尤其适合数学、科学问答、结构化答案比对这类高频需要 verifier 的场景。","technical_approach":"方法核心是 residual-guided non-parametric optimization。系统从一个固定 base verifier 出发，围绕它做迭代更新。每轮先在 construction pool 上回放当前 verifier，把预测与标注不一致的样本收集为 residuals。随后对这些 recurring errors 做模式归纳，形成 rule cards。每张 card 记录一种待补充的 verifier bias，包括支持样例、反例、适用条件，以及在什么情况下应 abstain。这里的设计很像把 verifier 的错误分析流程产品化：不是直接改模型参数，而是把 recurring mismatch 变成显式知识单元。\n\nrule card 有两条晋升路径。若某种偏置可以写成确定性的比较逻辑，例如数值容差、单位归一化、科学计数法转换、某些符号等价规则，就进入 code audit 和 replay validation，通过后成为 code module。code module 是一个三值判定单元：Correct / Incorrect / Abstain。若某类偏置无法完全规则化，仍需要模型判断，则不写成代码，而是并入 fallback verifier 的 prompt guidance。最终推理时，系统先走模块库，能直接判的就直接输出，不能判的再交给固定的 model-based fallback。这个结构的关键优点有两个：一是把高频、稳定的比较逻辑前移为显式模块，降低对大模型 judge 的依赖；二是每次更新都要经过 replay validation，避免新规则修正局部错误的同时引入直接回归。\n\n和已有方法相比，区别不在于又加了一个工具，而在于把 verifier 改进过程做成“残差发现—规则卡片—回放验证—模块/提示晋升”的闭环。它既不同于纯规则库的手工扩展，也不同于把所有复杂性都交给 judge model 吸收。","experiments":"论文在四个 reference-based verification benchmark 上评测。主结果是 AutoVerifier 达到 93.05% macro accuracy，超过文中对比的 rule-based、model-based、scientific 和 tool-augmented verifier。更有信息量的是分组件结果：相对 prompt-only 设置，加入 code modules 后 macro accuracy 再提升 1.76 个点，说明收益不只是 prompt 改写，而是显式比较逻辑确实补上了 verifier 的盲区。与此同时，能够由模块直接完成的判定还把 fallback model 调用减少了 32.13%，这意味着不仅更准，也更省推理成本。\n\n从论文描述看，实验重点不是追求某个 benchmark 上的极限分数，而是证明两件事：第一， recurring residuals 里确实存在可抽取、可复用的 verifier bias；第二，把这些 bias 以代码模块和 prompt guidance 分流实现，比单纯依赖 prompt 或单一 judge model 更稳。值得注意的是，这类结果的可信度很依赖 construction pool 与 benchmark 的分布关系；如果两者高度同分布，规则抽取会更容易。因此读实验时要特别看 replay validation、support/counterexample 设计，以及不同 benchmark 上的泛化是否一致。","reading_guide":"泛读时先看 The useful lesson is that NTP can be supplemented during training without changing the autoregressive inference path. The first is Multi-Token Prediction. Instead of using a hidden state only to predict the next image token, the model adds auxiliary heads that predict future tokens at multiple offsets. Each auxiliary MTP head contains additional transformer blocks followed by a linear output layer. These heads provide denser training signals to the shared backbone and are discarded at inference time, leaving standard autoregressive decoding unchanged. The second part is Token Contrastive Regularization. Since NTP mainly constrains output probabilities and does not explicitly shape hidden-state geometry, TCR uses other sampled tokens as negatives to make token representations more separable and less redundant. k(1 - beta) 给出更可解释的 horizon 估计。论文还给出非重叠分解下的 tightness 结果，以及缺少结构假设时的 impossibility 结论。","experiments":"实验覆盖六个 production LLM。论文报告 MTCR 给出的 certified bounds 在 epsilon-bounded adversary 设定下成立；在静态 epsilon-ball 攻击和 Crescendo-style adaptive attacks 下，经验安全率都高于认证下界，没有观察到违反 bound 的情况。文中给出一个示例说明朴素乘法的问题：如果每轮认证安全概率为 0.95，则 10 轮下界约为 0.60，20 轮约为 0.36，50 轮约为 0.08；如果要求 k 轮安全概率至少 0.9，只能支持约 2 轮。这组数字解释了为什么需要 compositional bounds 和 safety persistence。需要注意，形式化认证只覆盖 epsilon-bounded perturbations；Crescendo 这类语义级攻击主要作为经验测试，不在严格认证威胁模型内。","reading_guide":"建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。优先看 Problem Formulation，弄清 SA-MDP、k-turn certified robustness 和 naive multiplicative bound。然后看 compositional certification 和 (alpha, beta)-safety persistence 的定理陈述，不必逐行读证明。实验部分重点看六个 production LLM 的认证下界与经验攻击成功率之间的关系。对预训练研究员来说，最有用的部分不是具体认证算法，而是它把多轮安全分解成状态转移、模式结构和安全持久性的方式，可用于思考多轮 safety data、RL 训练信号和长对话评测。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"The paper addresses certified robustness for multi-turn LLM safety. The same-fact probes are important because they hold the underlying fact fixed while changing the elicitation format. The mitigation method, Recall-Anchored Distillation (RAD), adds an unlabeled OOD anchoring stream to the usual supervised target-domain loss. For each OOD prefix-continuation example, the frozen base model provides soft next-token distributions on continuation tokens, and the adapted model is trained to match them. This is a distributional anchor rather than answer replay. adapter，而是把“是否启用安全行为、启用到什么强度”变成输入条件化的连续控制问题。论文把这个问题落在 latent routing 上：冻结 backbone，只训练一个 safety LoRA 和一个很小的 gate，让模型在有害输入上更像安全模型，在无害输入上尽量保持原模型。","importance":"对预训练研究的直接启发不在“安全 benchmark 又涨了多少”，而在于它把 post-train alignment 里的 safety–utility trade-off 重新表述成条件化参数干预，而不是单一全局策略。这一点对 pretrain/post-train 接口很重要：如果对齐信号本身是稀疏且输入依赖的，那么把它硬写进全部参数往往会污染原有能力；相反，条件化路由更接近 mixture-of-behavior 的思路。CLEAR 还说明了一件实用的事：不需要外部大 guard model，也不需要重训 backbone，只用不到百万级参数的 gate 就能在 HarmBench 和 utility benchmark 上拿到更好的折中。这类方法对持续对齐、可撤销对齐、按风险分层的训练信号注入都有参考价值。","technical_approach":"方法结构很克制。第一部分是冻结的 backbone LLM；第二部分是 safety-specific LoRA，只负责学习“遇到危险请求时应如何偏向拒答/安全响应”；第三部分是 latent gate，根据输入的隐藏状态表示输出一个连续分数 g∈[0,1]，控制 LoRA 的注入强度。形式上不是简单地在输出端做 rerank 或加一个分类器，而是直接把门控写进层内权重更新：h'=(W+gΔW)h。这样做的意义是，安全干预不是离散开关，而是连续插值，模型可以在‘完全沿用原模型’和‘充分启用安全 adapter’之间平滑过渡。\n\n论文强调 gate 不是外置 moderation 模块，而是和 safety adapter 联合训练。训练上有两个关键设计。其一是 subtype-aware gate weighting：不同类型的 harmful/benign prompt 在训练 gate 时权重不同，目的是让 gate 不只学到粗糙的二分类，而是对安全相邻样本更敏感，减少 benign prompt 被误判为高风险。其二是 hard pairwise margin objective：显式拉开 harmful 与 benign prompt 在 gating space 里的间隔。这个设计很像把安全路由问题做成表示空间上的排序/间隔学习，而不是只靠 token-level generation loss 间接学出来。相比标准 LoRA，区别不在 adapter 本身，而在 adapter 的激活是 input-conditioned；相比外部 guard + base model 的两阶段方案，区别在于 gate 直接控制生成时的内部表示流，而不是先分类再硬切换模型。\n\n从全文表述看，CLEAR 的核心假设是：安全对齐造成的 utility tax，主要来自“对 benign prompt 施加了不必要的参数偏移”。因此它不追求让安全 adapter 本身更温和，而是尽量让 benign prompt 少经过 adapter。这个假设和方法是对齐的，也解释了为什么作者把 backbone 完全冻结：这样 utility preservation 更容易归因到 routing，而不是归因到更好的微调 recipe。","experiments":"实验主线比较清楚：安全看 HarmBench 和 XSTest，效用看 GSM8K、MMLU、TruthfulQA，底座主要是 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 和 Gemma-2-2B-it。结果上，CLEAR 的卖点不是把某一项能力推到极端，而是在几组基线之间拿到更好的 Pareto 点。\n\n在 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 上，论文报告 CLEAR 将 HarmBench attack success rate 压到接近 0；与现有安全对齐变体相比，CLEAR 的 ASR 为 0.50%，而其他对齐版本大约在 15.50% 到 24.00% 之间。与此同时，GSM8K 保留到 和“再加一个外部安全分类器”区分开了：参数量更小，部署链路更短，也避免了外部模型与主模型失配。\n\n从论文摘要和正文可见的消融重点，应该包括：去掉连续 gate、改成 always-on LoRA；去掉 pairwise margin；去掉 subtype-aware weighting；以及与 SFT、标准 LoRA、已有安全对齐模型的对比。最值得注意的不是绝对分数，而是这些消融是否证明 utility 改善确实来自条件化路由，而不是来自更弱的安全训练强度。如果正文表格里 CLEAR 在相近 ASR 下仍显著保留 GSM8K/TruthfulQA，那这个论点就站得住。","reading_guide":"泛读建议是先抓三件事。第一，看方法图和公式，确认 gate 控制的是层内 LoRA 强度，而不是输出后处理。第二，看训练目标部分，重点找 subtype-aware Standard PPO/GRPO/RLHF recipes rely on an action-side Policy-KL against a reference model. This stabilizes response updates, but it also consumes part of the exploration budget in response space. Removing it leaves the run exposed to drift and oscillation. The authors identify another source of instability: the model-induced likelihood of the training queries themselves changes as the policy is updated. Even with a fixed prompt corpus, the model’s autoregressive probability over these prompts drifts, creating an input-side non-stationarity that is not controlled by response-level KL.","importance":"The main value for pretraining-oriented research is the input-side view of post-training dynamics. RL updates do not only change answer behavior; they also reshape the model’s likelihood landscape over prompts and prefixes. That matters for continual pretraining, annealing, RLVR data selection, and the pretrain–posttrain interface. Moving part of the regularization from response space to query space may preserve more room for answer exploration while still controlling drift. The method itself is a moderate extension to existing RL pipelines, but the diagnostic framing is useful for studying collapse, high-temperature robustness, and prompt-mixture sensitivity in reasoning RL.","technical_approach":"The proposed method is ERPO. It defines a policy-induced query distribution ρ_θ(q)=P_θ(q), where the query is treated as a self-terminating autoregressive token sequence under the current model. The pre-RL model gives the reference distribution ρ_θ0. ERPO adds a Query-KL penalty, KL(ρ_θ || ρ_θ0), to limit drift in this input-side distribution. This differs from Policy-KL, which constrains π_θ(o|q), the response distribution conditioned on a query. A second component is a reference-derived, dataset-static per-query weight. Queries that are more typical under the reference distribution receive more stable update weights, which is intended to reduce variance and improve behavior under high-temperature sampling. The implementation is shown on top of GRPO, but the components are designed to be compatible with PPO, REINFORCE-style estimators, RLOO, and related advantage-based objectives.","experiments":"The provided text reports the main empirical pattern but not the full numerical tables. The key diagnostic result is that, under a fixed action-level Policy-KL budget, response-level Policy-KL remains roughly flat while the estimated Query-KL keeps increasing over training. This supports the claim that action-side regularization does not control input-side drift. The authors evaluate on reasoning benchmarks and report consistent accuracy gains for ERPO. They also use multi-temperature sampling with Pass@k, Pass@1, and Avg@k, which is appropriate because high-temperature decoding exposes long-tail instability. The visible text does not specify model sizes, data scale, benchmark names, or exact improvement margins, so the strength of the empirical claim should be checked in the full result tables.","reading_guide":"Skim in 20–30 minutes.
